answer: Defend an agent economy with compute-backed identity rings: each identity accumulates non-transferable proof-of-work certificates issued only for verified useful computation, layered like rings under bark until the identity stands as firm as a cedar. New identities face an onboarding ridge — a steep cost curve where each fake identity demands real GPU-hours, so mass fabrication scales the electricity bill, not the profit. Cross-identity traffic carries a whisper of shared compute lineage, so a farm of fakes betrays one origin fingerprint and gets flagged before it can vote.
